description: Every system the mashup touches in Left 4 Dead 2. Each row generates one piece of code in source/islandoutbreak.sp.

rows.system: Read HKIA island data at startup from the player's own install
rows.readsFromHKIA: StreamingAssets/EntityScenes/*.entities under {game:custom-hello-kitty-island-adventure} via ISLAND_PATH env var

rows.system: Theme the safe room on a real HKIA region; announce it in chat
rows.readsFromHKIA: region name picked from HKIA entity files at runtime
rows.chatAnnouncement: This safe room is themed on <Region> from Hello Kitty Island Adventure

rows.system: Call out an island supply treat drawn from real HKIA items
rows.readsFromHKIA: item name picked from HKIA entity files at runtime

rows.system: Write a test marker so Melty's test can confirm the mashup played, not only started
Publish the listen server address to Melty's join log so friends can connect with one click
